subject: general
question: A car covers a certain distance at a speed of 45 km/h and returns to the starting point following the same path at a speed of 36 km/h. Find the average speed for the entire journey (in km/h).
solution:
**Given:**

Speed at the time of going = 45 km/h

Speed at the time of return to the starting point = 36 km/h.

**Concept used:**

When distance is constant then,

Average speed = (2xy)/(x + y)

Here,

x = Speed at time of going

y = speed at the time of returning

**Calculation:**

Average speed = (2 × 45 × 36)/(45 + 36) km/hr.

⇒ (2 × 45 × 36)/81 km/hr.

⇒ (3240)/81 km/hr.

⇒ 40 km/hr.

**∴ The average speed for the entire journey (in km/h) is 40.**
